articles.headline: Ethereum ETFs lose $103M as Bitcoin ETFs gain $527M ahead of Fed meeting, risking ETH price drop to $2,300.
articles.description: Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) saw $103.3 million in outflows on October 19, led by BlackRock's ETHA, while Bitcoin ETFs attracted $526.7 million, highlighting a strong investor preference for Bitcoin over Ethereum. This outflow trend has pushed Ethereum's price below $2,500, with a potential downside risk to $2,300 before the Federal Reserve's policy decision on October 28. Despite weak institutional demand, Bitmine Immersion Technologies continues accumulating Ethereum, holding over 6 million ETH tokens. The market remains sensitive to macroeconomic factors, and Ethereum's price could either recover to $2,500 or fall further depending on ETF flows and Fed policy outcomes.

JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Puts JPM Coin on Ethereum for Institutional Payments
articles.description:
JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) has extended its JPM Coin payment system to the Ethereum mainnet, moving beyond its private Quorum network.
The USD-backed deposit token will now be available to institutional clients on a public blockchain infrastructure alongside existing permissioned rails.
JPMorgan is positioning the Ethereum rollout as a way to increase interoperability and liquidity for blockchain based treasury and settlement flows.
